articles.title: UKPNP condemns reported civilian killings, alleged drone attacks, shelling in Rawalakot
articles.description: The United Kashmir Peoples National Party UKPNP has condemned reported civilian killings alleged drone attacks mortar shelling and heavy weapons fire in Rawalakot in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir PoJK and called for an independent international investigation into the incidents According to a post on X by UKPNP leader Sardar Nasir Aziz Khan the party alleged that Pakistani security forces used drones mortar shells and heavy weapons in civilian-populated areas resulting in multiple deaths and injuries
